title: Transition guard consults mem only
impact: PG-mode row absent from memById skips canTransition; a terminal row can be rewound by a stale/cross-process writer.
fix: Read row from PG or use a CAS update (WHERE status IN allowed) before writing; add PG-mode test. [recon 2026-10-07: code-fix verified; ledger has no Status column]

title: Schema drift child_run_id FK
impact: Migration 0024 dropped delegations.child_run_id FK but schema still declares references(runs.id); drizzle-kit generate would re-add it and re-break prod inserts (silent mem fallback).
fix: Remove the child references from schema.ts; verify generate diff is empty. [recon 2026-10-07: code-fix verified; ledger has no Status column]

title: Truncation message overstates artifact content
impact: Message claims 'full output stored as artifact' but contentRef = fullOutput.slice(0,20000); >20k tails are lost silently.
fix: Store up to the artifact limit and state stored length, or amend the message. [recon 2026-10-07: code-fix verified; ledger has no Status column]

title: Abort after persist leaves pending rows
impact: createTasks runs before the post-plan abort check; cancel between plan and dispatch leaves swarm_tasks rows pending with no terminal settle.
fix: Move the abort check before delete/create or settle rows on cancel.

title: Blocked asymmetry in result map
impact: Rows persist blocked (:242,:257) but dispatchResults records failed with a 'blocked:' reason; map-only consumers see failed.
fix: Record status blocked in the map or document the map contract (aggregator prefers row status). [recon 2026-10-07: code-fix verified; ledger has no Status column]

title: deleteByRun swallows DB failure then clears mem
impact: Caller cannot distinguish failed PG delete from success; stale rows can survive and collide on re-run (see SW-07).
fix: Propagate failure or return status; clear mem only after confirmed delete. [recon 2026-10-07: code-fix verified; ledger has no Status column]

title: createTasks PK collision path
impact: Stale runId::taskId rows make INSERT fail; catch stores memOnly rows while PG keeps stale rows; cross-process reads see stale status.
fix: Upsert (onConflictDoUpdate) or transactional delete-then-insert; verify delete result.

title: Lazy-create completion
impact: completeDelegation creates a row without a prior delegate(); guards now match but strict prerequisite target unmet (docs Q1 open).
fix: Operator decision Q1; if strict, reject when no delegation row exists.

title: Duplicate SWARM_V1 readers
impact: Router and swarm-types each parse SWARM_V1; matching-rule changes can desync rollback vs gate.
fix: Use isSwarmV1Enabled via the gate or a shared env helper.

title: Silent traversal caps
impact: getChainDepth/getVisitedSet break at >100 hops or on revisit without reporting; deep chains get truncated depth.
fix: Return a capped flag or raise; log at cap.

title: Plain-object throws
impact: throw {task,error,durationMs} cast to Error loses stack and instanceof semantics.
fix: Throw an Error subclass carrying task/duration fields.

title: Timeout leaves worker running
impact: withTimeout abandons the promise; a late worker still mutates shared usage after its task was reported failed.
fix: Thread abortSignal into the worker or gate usage accrual by settlement.

title: Stale SWARM_V1 description
impact: Describe mentions 'BullMQ/leases via heartbeats'; dispatcher is in-process bounded fan-out + heartbeat lease (no BullMQ).
fix: Update the describe text.

title: Global mem cap eviction
impact: 500-row process cap can evict live rows in hermetic/local mode; tasks silently lost.
fix: Document or per-run LRU; local file tier is the real fix (docs gap).

title: Unbounded LLM strings
impact: id/goal/description have no length caps before DB insert/prompt reuse.
fix: Cap lengths in parsePlanJson.

title: Guard fail-open on unexpected errors
impact: Non-DelegationRejected gate errors warn and proceed unguarded (silent guard-off on DB outage).
fix: Decide fail-open vs fail-closed; if open, emit a metric/log line.

title: Cross-domain test imports
impact: check-gates TEST-ONLY findings (4): provider-registry, runtime-kernel, swarm-runtime internals.
fix: Route via runtime gate when touching; non-fatal per script.

title: Repository-to-repository test coupling
impact: swarm-repository imports resetDelegationRepositoryForTests only to compose resetSwarmForTests.
fix: Move combined reset into a test helper.

title: Synthetic fallback rows lose blocked status
impact: When listByRun is empty, synthesized rows derive only completed/failed; blocked appears failed in the row view.
fix: Map 'blocked:' reasons to blocked or reuse the aggregator prefix rule.

title: Delegation payload type gap
impact: Payloads include workspaceId (socket room scoping) but interfaces omit it; emits bypass typing with casts.
fix: Add workspaceId to both payload interfaces; drop casts.
